rows.name: Moderation
rows.nexus: Kick, ban, mute, warn, purge, slowmode and channel locks. Every action gets a case number and the member gets a DM. Nexus checks the role hierarchy, so lower roles can't act on higher ones.

rows.name: Case history
rows.nexus: Look up a member's full history, open any case by its number, or let members check their own record.

rows.name: AutoMod
rows.nexus: Catches spam and scam links, and can lock the server down during a raid. Each type has its own sensitivity from 1 to 10, and trusted users and roles can be whitelisted.

rows.name: Autoroles
rows.nexus: Roles on join, roles that stick when someone leaves and comes back, and timed roles that remove themselves.

rows.name: Tickets
rows.nexus: Members open a private channel with one click. Staff can add or remove people, then close it when it's handled.

rows.name: Logging
rows.nexus: Nine categories, from messages and users to moderation actions and role changes, each sent to its own channel.

rows.name: Server stats
rows.nexus: Message and voice activity from the last 30 days as graphs, for a person, a channel or the whole server. Also joins, leaves and which invite brought people in.

rows.name: Giveaways
rows.nexus: Custom durations, winner counts and rerolls.

rows.name: Reminders
rows.nexus: Personal reminders in plain time formats like 1h30m.

rows.name: Starboard
rows.nexus: React to a message and the community favorites get pinned to their own channel.

rows.name: Translation
rows.nexus: Translate a message into another language without leaving Discord.

rows.name: Games
rows.nexus: 10 games from one menu, played against Nexus or a friend.

rows.name: Leveling and XP
rows.nexus: Not in Nexus yet. You'd still need a separate bot for this.

rows.nexus: Not in Nexus yet. You'd still need a separate bot for this.
